# obot_mcp_tunnels (Data Source)

Lists configured MCP tunnel definitions, sorted by ID. An empty installation returns an empty list. Includes token previews only; complete tokens cannot be recovered by a data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "obot_mcp_tunnels" "all" {}

# .tunnels is a list of definitions sorted by ID, with token previews only.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tunnels` (Attributes List) Configured tunnel definitions; connection status is not part of the definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnels))

<a id="nestedatt--tunnels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tunnels`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_urls` (Set of String) Permitted target URL or hostname patterns. An empty set denies all targets.
- `description` (String) Description of the tunnel's purpose.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable tunnel display name.
- `id` (String) The generated Obot tunnel ID.
- `token_preview` (String) Non-secret shortened preview. The complete token cannot be read from Obot.
